column1: # libmc entry points named from the save API's use of them: each call stores its in-flight flag at the
# request number sceMcSync reports for it (1 GetInfo, 2 Open, 3 Close, 4 Seek, 6 Write, 10 Flush,
# 16 Format), and its arguments are that function's (port, slot, ...) or (fd, ...). sceMcInit runs
# once after mcman.irx and mcserv.irx are loaded.
